metadata.name: LightLog Phase 3 Stress Holdout Corpus
metadata.purpose: Fresh stress/generalization holdout; do not inspect before freezing production recognizer and knowledge changes.

priorityMeaning.P0: Uncommon but deterministic daily bookkeeping; should pass.
priorityMeaning.P1: Complex valid transaction; strong robustness target.
priorityMeaning.P2: Ambiguous/OCR/safety boundary; warning or block is acceptable where specified, but confident wrong is unacceptable.

blindUse: Keep this file outside the repository until recognizer/knowledge changes are frozen.
Do not grep/search/read individual cases before the first evaluation.
After first evaluation, treat this corpus as regression data, not as a future blind holdout.
Do not hard-code exact strings from this corpus.
